prompts.task: Perform a focused read-only supplemental audit and propose source-backed per-function producer decisions and concrete future acceptance in .observe/per-function-decorator-audit.md and .json. Do not execute SDK/probes or close canonical findings from this snapshot. Use per-function-decorator-gate-evidence.json as independent source evidence, not live app.py state. The exact original demo7932ce33 snapshots contain agent.call_model and tools.execute_tool/tools.retrieve_documents coroutines plus agent.run_agent async generator. Assess every function separately with actual path/qualified name, span_type, shape, pre-existing ownership, native SDK @log source/probe capabilities for raw capture/privacy, protocol/lifecycle/partial/close/cancel, creation-time kind/attributes and sink, chosen function pattern, exact applicable limitation, test acceptance and remaining proof. SDK async/async-generator dispatch support is real supplied source evidence; do not reject a shape merely because it yields or is async. Current source can make direct native capture unsafe through raw-input overwrite, full model response capture, result/null/partial behavior or document content/identity adaptation; source facts and unavailable current runtime support must stay separate. Preserve existing OTel/Galileo producer/export paths, fill only gaps, and never add a duplicate producer. A public helper may be used inside a justified application-owned FUNCTION decorator; bare with/manual scopes on new functions, helper-first preference, post-export sanitization or a redacted companion do not implement this gate. Non-function lifetimes and pre-existing owned scopes are separate. Do not invent a helper kind argument or fix CLIENT/initial-attribute limits by late enrichment. Also assess the separate later full-conformance repair snapshot and synthetic business values in per-function-full-conformance-evidence.json. Keep its existing instrument_model_call SDK ownership separate from the original uninstrumented7932ce33 functions. The operator now requests complete model conformance: use the supplied helper/schema/converter and public OTel interface evidence to choose the smallest supported per-operation repair, required capture and validation, preserving working SDK agent/tool/retrieval creators and the registered provider/export paths. Distinguish this source-supported repair choice from historical cases with genuinely unavailable capability evidence. Assess typed tool-call round trips, failures before any valid response, initial kind/attributes and conditional remote versus deterministic branches; do not claim this read-only proposal executed or passed application verification. Make the strict future acceptance checks individually locatable, with equivalent table rows, prose or JSON accepted and no prescribed keys: complete input/output message validation against the applicable supplied/current schema; each known concrete part type validated against its own schema definition; and equality of an available tool-call ID from the model tool-request part through the owning tool span to the corresponding tool response in the next model input. Name the schema/provenance targets and actual values to compare, preserve policy-safe joins, and mark these future execution checks Not run rather than claiming observed validation or correlation. Retain each actual supplied tool-call ID. If a provider omits an optional ID, keep that provider message ID absent and distinguish any execution ID that the application source itself already generates downstream. Do not propose new telemetry-only IDs or retrofit an execution ID into the earlier provider response to manufacture a three-boundary join; report the actual available correlation and its limit. A named concrete ToolCallResponsePart schema validator enforces its required response field; equivalent precise validator acceptance is sufficient without redundant literal property-name narration. In the source assessment, explicitly account for every supplied observed native/source/probe limit separately from future acceptance. Decode any serialized probe payloads and normalize IDs before comparing the current business-call span with that operation's emitted leaf and parent; state the actual result for each affected function. Describe the supplied retrieval wire's actual query/document content and metadata representation instead of inferring rejection, omission or compatibility only from source types. Decode the native gen_ai.retrieval.query.text representation and compare it with the actual query consumed by the function, distinguishing a serialized bound-arguments wrapper from a plain query string. A faithful document-shape summary identifying source fields, native content/metadata placement and provenance is sufficient; do not require duplicate literal document values or repeated JSON copies. Where supplied, identify the selected LlmSpan output default/validator behavior and whether the converter maps output unconditionally, not only the downstream consequence. Keep observed facts, proposed repair and unexecuted proof distinct. Include a prospective source-plan closure handoff: after an authorized implementation applies the selected repair, run verification; if the selected contract fails, route the defect to scoped instrumentation repair and rerun the focused verification scenarios until the selected contract passes or an exact external blocker is established. Do not manufacture an initial failure or claim this read-only assessment performed those steps. Rebuild and reconcile the canonical .observe/otel-instrumentation.json, .observe/otel-instrumentation.md, .observe/otel-instrumentation.html, .observe/otel-verify.json and .observe/otel-verify.md from the current producer and actual evidence after repair; verification state refreshes within otel-instrumentation.html rather than a standalone verification HTML artifact. Do not carry stale SDK creator, kind or failure-output claims into the repaired reports. State this as future acceptance and ownership handoff only; do not write or regenerate canonical application reports in this supplemental read-only task. Read supplied files only: no original demo/fixture/code/input/dependency/profile/test/skill/global edits, package installation/import, SDK/model/app/probe/receiver/registry/cloud/network execution or UI/browser. Write only the named supplemental.observe artifacts. Dated versions are scoped evidence; actual future application still needs task-time newest-compatible resolution, selected public APIs and immutable checked apply. Keep unexecuted compatibility/runtime/receiver/creation-time claims Not run/Not proven.

judge_inputs: Read the shared source evidence, loaded target skill/shared AO gate and generated supplemental Markdown/JSON, actor trace, last_message and grade. Source snapshots remain separate from real fixtureapp.py. Compare actual chosen per-function producer patterns and acceptance, not headings, decorator keyword counts or generic copied rules.

Return exactly six ordered rubric checks with IDs rubric-1 through rubric-6. Equivalent precise prose/JSON/grouping is accepted only if every actual function/candidate decision and evidence is individually locatable. These tasks are read-only plan/source assessments; no SDK installation, actual probe/app/receiver/cloud execution is required or fabricated.

Input contains exact source/receipt/probe facts and neutral implementation candidates, not the selection/verdict answer ledger. Current SDK graph, safe_capture implementation, real fallback execution and native routing are unavailable; assess precise source limits while preserving historical facts and existing producers.

The new full-conformance packet is a separate later repair snapshot, with immutable source/interface/schema excerpts and synthetic business inputs, not an expected repair implementation or executed output. Compare its concrete repair choice and required acceptance against available public capability evidence. Keep historical missing-evidence blocked-plan allowances, but they do not justify leaving a documented available selected model repair unplanned or treating Partial as full-conformance completion. No runtime tests or application Pass may be fabricated in these read-only tasks.
rubric: Identifies all four exact demo functions and actual coroutine/async-generator/span_type/ownership/dataflow separately. call_model remote Ollama versus local rule engine is conditional source applicability; execute_tool/search_docs->retrieve_documents nested operations and run_agent single invocation are preserved, without fake workflow/extra wrappers or attributing snapshots to fixtureapp.py.

Assesses public native SDK @log first for each fresh function from exact dated source/native-probe and installed-source receipts. Distinguishes supported dispatch from raw-input overwrite/privacy, full model response/hidden fields, null/partial output, document schema, bounded collection/protocol/close/cancel and sink/creation-time gaps; unsupported or unexecuted facts remain explicit. A blanket async/generator/custom-sink blocker or generic helper preference is not a capability decision. Uses the fresh public localhost native probe as scoped real SDK capture, not cloud/app proof: safe dispatch/async-generator output exists; raw mapped/redacted sentinel remains in canonical native tool content, null/error empty-object capture is not a real produced result, model-shaped JSON lacks native usage/finish mapping, and demo-shaped documents are emitted as serialized Document.content with empty metadata rather than rejected/dropped. Decodes native gen_ai.retrieval.query.text and distinguishes the JSON-string bound-query argument wrapper from the plain query value consumed by the retriever. Faithful summaries of document shape with source-field identity, native content/metadata placement and source/probe provenance satisfy this assessment without duplicate literal document values or repeated JSON copies. Native business-call current context remains the agent rather than the leaf; this limits nested transport correlation even when exported leaf parentage exists. Do not invent native rejection or dismiss ordinary public SDK routing because a private/custom sink is unavailable. In the separate strict repair snapshot, reads the exact selected helper no-kind/no-initial-attributes signature and finally mapping, LlmSpan non-nullable Message output with empty-assistant default plus rejecting-None validator, and unconditional output conversion. These are source facts for the selected APIs, not proof that a required field with no default is missing or that every future SDK version/API is incapable. Relates them to requested CLIENT/on_start and genuinely absent response; checks public native/SDK alternatives before an operation-specific exception.

Where native public configuration meets a safe source contract, proposes/retains native function decoration. Any fallback has a precise applicable source/probe mismatch and a named application-owned FUNCTION decorator around a supported same-boundary creator, preserving business inputs/results/errors and one producer. Direct manual context-manager scopes for a fresh function do not satisfy this requirement even when SDK span fields look correct; post-export filtering or redacted companion does not suppress original SDK capture. Unsupported helper CLIENT/initial attribute arguments, private injection and duplicate spans fail. A read-only source proposal may leave CLIENT or initial-attribute capability unresolved, but the affected capability/implementation must remain Partial or Not proven; it must not call an incompatible creator fully supported or invent unsupported arguments. A concrete proposed decorator symbol/attachment and a scoped pattern decision are still required. The same scoped rule applies to unavailable privacy, generator lifecycle, schema/serialization or sink capability: a read-only plan may mark the function Not configured/Partial only with a concrete proposed decorator symbol/attachment, checked documented public creator candidate, exact blocked contract and required acceptance/proof. It may not imply an executable compliant creator, apply changes or claim whole-implementation Pass. For the strict full-model request, proposes a concrete minimal public OTel model FUNCTION decorator/creator when the selected SDK routes cannot meet those source-proven required contracts, using the documented Tracer kind and attributes at creation on the same registered provider. Does not retain an incompatible helper as the completed solution merely labeled Partial when that supported repair can be planned. Does not default to OTel for supported SDK operations, invent a helper kind argument, mutate private span/schema fields, change kind in an exporter, create a companion/duplicate model span or rewrite the whole app. Actual current compatibility and repaired runtime remain Not proven in this source-only task. When the selected required contract and source-supported implementation authorization cover this minimal repair, it does not require a second permission request solely because the SDK operation creator changes; document the scoped capability exception instead of adding an approval blocker.

Provides concrete scoped fallback/native acceptance for raw-secret absence before every SDK/native/export path, same-span content equality and null/no-result/produced-partial preservation, actual parent/count, cancellation/re-raised errors, normal iteration/early close and any unknown send/asend/throw/athrow contract. Async-generator run_agent remains eligible in principle; finite step count alone does not bound content/history, and sampler/on_start/public sink/runtime proof is not invented. Strict model acceptance compares useful typed tool_call parts with real safe name/arguments and the provided health-call-7 ID, and tool_call_response parts with that same ID and produced response in request history; output tool calls stay structured rather than JSON dumped into a text part. Requires the complete input/output message schema and a separate validation of each known concrete part type against the supplied or task-time fetched current schema, with recorded per-payload/type results or explicitly unexecuted future acceptance. For tool_call_response, the produced value is in the required response field; content alone is not a valid replacement even if a permissive top-level message schema accepts it. Naming and applying the concrete ToolCallResponsePart validator can satisfy this field acceptance without redundant literal property narration; the actual or proposed content-only mapping remains invalid. Preserves known tool-call IDs unchanged across the model request part, owning tool span and produced result in the next model request history, with matching names and safe arguments/results. Only a concrete content policy may require changing an ID, and then one consistent safe mapping must preserve the join across all three boundaries; unknown IDs are not invented. When the provider omits an optional ID, leaves that provider message ID absent and distinguishes any source-owned downstream execution ID; it must not propose telemetry-only ID generation, retrofit an application execution ID into the earlier provider response, or claim a provider-to-tool join that source values cannot support. Existing source-owned execution IDs may be reported only where the business source actually produces them, with the unavailable provider correlation stated explicitly. Known structured parts are not silently dropped, flattened or converted to text to bypass concrete-part validation. Preserves safe source values and redacts the supplied argument/result/hidden-reasoning sentinels before capture, within bounds. Provider failure, timeout, HTTP500, invalid response and cancellation before valid completion have no fabricated output.messages, empty assistant completion, response usage or finish; errors propagate and the one span ends once. Requires sampler/on_start to observe network CLIENT and known safe operation/provider/request model/controls, active model context for nested HTTP, final same-span/wire schema/value checks and no duplicates; deterministic demo has no remote CLIENT or invented inference usage.

Preserves independently pre-existing OTel and Galileo producer/provider/export ownership, including their manual source scopes, rather than retroactively rewriting them solely to fit the new-function decorator gate. Existing field/lifecycle proof gaps can be enriched/tested separately without claiming migration, adding a second creator or treating Galileo export processing as fresh span creation. The later strict case permits replacement of only its source-proven incompatible SDK model creator under the explicit full-conformance request, retaining its existing function decorator boundary, app-owned provider/local OTLP/conditional AO processor, metrics/logs and independently supported SDK agent/tool/retrieval producers. It must not register a new provider or duplicate AO exporter, silently migrate the separate existing valid OTel/Galileo cases, depend on gateway reachability to implement local semantics, or claim resource/cloud success from local source plans.

Audit records concrete proposed native-first decisions or exactly justified function-decorator fallbacks in finding-like required_fix/evidence/acceptance content, with all four boundaries individually addressable. Source support is not measured compatibility, installed emission or completed fallback testing. Correct source proposals remain proposed; no unsupported whole-app Pass or live AO/receiver claim. Adds an actionable strict-model required_fix with exact source-backed SDK limits, chosen supported public per-operation repair and success/tool-roundtrip/no-response/on_start verification acceptance. It must not close runtime findings or stop the requested remedial plan at a generic unsupported-SDK Partial when the supplied public OTel interface supports the required kind/attributes. Its prospective report handoff names the canonical .observe/otel-instrumentation.json, .observe/otel-instrumentation.md, .observe/otel-instrumentation.html, .observe/otel-verify.json and .observe/otel-verify.md, with verification state refreshed inside otel-instrumentation.html rather than a separate verification HTML artifact. The source-only assessment does not execute or fabricate those reports.
